verdict.rationale: Headless or programmatic automation is a fair question for a government business-filing service, since such services can offer filing APIs or bulk interfaces. The evidence shows only interactive, OHID-authenticated web portals, with no documented API, CLI, or CI-friendly access path. The probes recorded 403 responses at robots.txt on both ohiosos.gov and the Business Central portal, so nothing in the pack shows the product supports unattended automation.
